## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 右栏的「AI 副驾」分段上加一个数字徽标，看属性时底部折叠条读「AI 副驾 · N 项待确认 · 回到对话 →」；N 是副驾最新一张「修改方案 · N 项」卡的条数（搭建方案算 1 项）。点了「存为草稿 / 确认」或改动落地，徽标和文字立刻消失。
- 为什么改：#25943 Target 第 1、2 项要「N 项待确认」计数；main 上只有一个「方案待确认」小圆点，而且只认搭建方案，副驾给已上线应用提的「修改方案」卡根本不会点亮它。
- 风险与回滚：控制台的对话启动器（右下角 FAB、ChatDock 边条）现在在「修改方案」卡待确认时也会亮提示点，这是有意的行为扩展；plugin-chatbot 的回调多一个参数，只读第一个参数的宿主不受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`（`newestProposal` 一段）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/assistant/assistantBus.ts`（按会话存条数）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioRightSlot.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.planApprovalCount-25943.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/__tests__/studioRightSlot-12725.test.tsx`，预期全部通过，其中 zh 用例断言折叠条读「AI 副驾 · 3 项待确认」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Part of #25943

Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What changes

The card's Target 1–6 were measured on `main` @ `481ade61` first: items 1–6 already hold (the right slot, select-to-properties, the copilot strip and canvas hint, no 源码 tab, the status line and the item ⋯ menu, change card v2, the 变更 badge and 「草稿 · N 项未发布」, pillar labels from `lg`), with one gap: the copilot segment and the folded strip carried a boolean 「方案待确认」 dot, not a count, and only for a build plan. This PR closes that gap.

- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `ChatbotEnhanced`.** The newest-proposal reading behind `onPlanApprovalPendingChange` now also counts a change plan (`proposedChanges`, the 「修改方案 · N 项」 card). A change plan is pending while its card still offers its confirm / 存为草稿 button: no replay verdict, no later same-tool commit, no click in flight (`confirmPendingIds`), no quota refusal (`quotaBlockedChanges`). The callback gains a second argument, `count`: the rows of a pending change plan, 1 for a pending build plan, 0 when nothing is pending. It fires when either value changes, and still keys on the reading alone, not the callback's identity.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`, assistant bus.** `publishPlanApprovalPending` takes an optional `count` (defaults to 1 while pending) and keeps it per conversation beside the owner. `usePlanApprovalPending()` is unchanged in meaning (any pending reading of the signed-in user). New `usePlanApprovalPendingCount()` sums the user's conversations. `ChatPane` publishes the chat's count with its boolean.
- **Studio right slot.** `StudioCopilotStatus` carries `planPendingCount` in place of `planPending`. The copilot tab's dot becomes a count badge, and the strip reads `AI 副驾 · {count} 项待确认` (en `AI copilot · {count} awaiting your approval`) through the new studio key `engine.studio.slot.pendingCount`; the tab's accessible description is the same sentence.
- **Docs.** `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/README.md` describes the two-argument callback and the change-plan reading. `content/docs/frontend/` has no page that documents this prop, so none changed.

## Tests

- New `ChatbotEnhanced.planApprovalCount-25943.test.tsx` (5 cases, real wire envelopes through the real mapper, each asserting the reading and the card it mirrors): a change plan awaiting 存为草稿 reads `[true, 2]`; the click reads `[false, 0]` at once (applying); a drafted replay reads `[false, 0]`; a build plan reads `[true, 1]` and a newer change plan supersedes it with its rows (an unchanged reading is not re-announced); nothing proposed reads `[false, 0]`.
- New `planApprovalPendingCount-25943.test.tsx` (4 cases) for the bus: the per-conversation sum, a count change, a reading without a count counts 1, another user's readings are not counted.
- `AiChatPage.planApprovalReachesLaunchers-11666.test.tsx` gains one case: the chat's count reaches the bus and its end clears it.
- `StudioDesignSurface.rightSlot-12725.test.tsx`: the marker case now counts (badge `2`, description and strip text), plus a case with nothing pending. `studioRightSlot-12725.test.tsx` gains the zh strip case 「AI 副驾 · 3 项待确认」.
- Five existing slot test doubles move from `planPending` to `planPendingCount`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Card Acceptance.** 1: the slot's own cases were already on `main` (`StudioDesignSurface.rightSlot-12725`, `pillarsClaimSlot-12725`, `leafColumnSelection-12725`, `kanbanCardSelection-12725`, `copilotDraftBadge-12725`, `itemDraftLine-12725`); this PR adds the count. 2: screenshots are **NOT MEASURED** — a local backend serves no AI agent catalog, so the copilot half never mounts and no proposal can be produced; the DOM is pinned by the jsdom cases above. 3: see the readings above; the whole `@object-ui/app-shell` suite (1,911 files) is left to CI `Test UI`.
- **What stays on the card (B, not ui work).** The live 草稿 chip and 「由 AI 副驾在 N 分钟前作为草稿加入」 do not show on staging because the copilot's drafts are stamped `by: "api"`: the producer (cloud `service-ai-studio`, `stageDraft` / `applyDraft`) does not pass `surface: 'copilot'`, and this repo's HTTP doors refuse `copilot` from a client by design. The ui code for the marks is on `main`. Carrier: cloud.
- **Measured, not a proven ui defect (C).** On staging the Interfaces inspector opened `hcpl_book.default` (404 on `GET /meta/view/...`) while the copilot drafted `hcpl_book.list`. Reading of `main`: `listViewTargetOf` falls back to `OBJECT.default` when no merged list view is flagged `isDefault`, and the runtime's `ObjectView` promotes the object's embedded `list` under that same identity (`defaultListViewId`) as its default tab, so for an object that declares `list` the inspector and the runtime agree, and the view the copilot edited is a secondary one. They would disagree only for an object with neither `list` nor a flagged view, where the runtime shows the first list view; whether `hcpl_book` is that case was not measurable from here. Not changed.
- **Behaviour widened on purpose.** The console launchers' waiting marker (objectui#11666) now also lights for a pending change plan, since the reading counts one.
- **The count is the user's, not the package's.** Like the boolean before it, the bus sums every conversation of the signed-in user, so a plan awaiting approval in another app's conversation also counts in this Studio's strip.
- `engine.studio.slot.planPending` is no longer read but stays in the studio table, so the i18n change only widens; retiring it is a narrowing for a later sweep.
- The harness's after-PR assignee / review request was skipped on the maintainer's rule (the seat reviews first).
- **An empty change plan.** `ChatbotEnhanced` would report `(true, 0)` for a pending `proposedChanges` with no rows; the assistant bus clamps a pending reading to at least 1. No such card reaches the chat today: the mapper lifts `proposedChanges` only when the envelope carries at least one parseable change row (objectui#8343), so there is no visible defect in this repository. (Added by the seat from contract review 6510852862.)
